outcome: Canonical identities and label targets can only be constructed through checked invariants.

artifacts.purpose: Checked IDs, vocabulary, label indexes, Episode and Outcome records; Prediction is implemented with ObservationSet in T004
Use an established UUID primitive with only required parsing features

interfaces: EpisodeId, RunId, SourceId, ArtifactDigest are distinct types.
LabelVocabulary owns ordered exact strings and lookup; LabelIndex cannot be freely serialized or mixed across datasets.
Episode<Target> owns required opaque input once; Outcome<Target> distinguishes checked answered/abstained records. Prediction<Output> is implemented by T004 after ObservationSet exists.
acceptance_criteria: UUID text must be canonical lowercase hyphenated, non-nil/non-max; standard versions allowed.
Vocabulary rejects blank or duplicate labels and respects task-specific minimum size, case, whitespace, Unicode.
Fields remain private; expose no mutable construction bypass or generic task/plugin trait.

verification.expected: Sentinels/noncanonical UUID/digest rejected; valid existing versions accepted.
No trimming/normalization; duplicates and blank entries rejected.

verification_responsibility: A different agent from the implementation author reruns evidence and reviews every acceptance criterion; integrator accepts only the saved response.
common_completion_checks: All listed artifacts contain implemented behavior or required evidence; no placeholders.

All tests assigned to this task are listed by Cargo and execute with a nonzero expected test count. Compound conformance/structure cases have explicit later audit test owners in coverage.json; implementers still test each local invariant now.
Relevant fmt/Clippy/test/build checks pass on the pinned toolchain; no bypass, changed tolerance or weakened oracle.
Saved response records exact input/source/output hashes, commands, exit codes, expected/actual results, and unresolved failures.
New or changed-authority artifacts are indexed; operational state is updated in Fizzy after acceptance.
